questions.explanation: Fix a start vertex, arrange the other 7 vertices in (8-1) factorial ways, then divide by 2 because each cycle is traced in two directions, giving 2520. The required result is 2520.
questions.hint: Fix a start and divide by two for the two directions.

questions.subject: MATH
questions.learningObjective: Solve problems involving euler and hamilton circuits.
questions.stem: A connected graph has exactly 12 vertices of odd degree. What is the minimum number of trails needed to cover every edge exactly once?
questions.explanation: Odd-degree vertices can be paired up, and each pair needs one trail, so 12 odd vertices require 6 trails to cover all edges. The required result is 6.
questions.hint: Pair the odd vertices; each pair accounts for one trail.

options.misconception: Wrong belief "uses one trail per odd vertex" gives 16, not 8.
Wrong belief "adds a spurious extra trail" gives 9, not 8.

questions.explanation: Odd-degree vertices can be paired up, and each pair needs one trail, so 16 odd vertices require 8 trails to cover all edges.
